ideas.title: Investigating the Impact of Medicaid Funding Cuts on Transgender Youth
ideas.description: This story would investigate the effects of the Trump administration's decision to end Medicaid funding for child sex-change procedures on transgender youth and their families.
questions: What are the immediate and long-term effects of this funding cut on transgender youth?
How will this decision impact the healthcare and well-being of affected individuals?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose the human cost of the administration's decision and highlight the need for further investigation and advocacy on behalf of transgender youth.
